Topic.label: Integrated Practice: Designing a Venue for a School Track and Field Meet

Question: One lap along the inner edge of a track measures 400 m and consists of two identical straight sections (90 m each) and two semicircular bends. Use \(\pi=22/7\). The two semicircular bends together form a circle. What is the diameter of this circle in m?
Solution: The total length of the bends is \(400-2\times90=220\) m, so the circumference of the circle is \(\pi d=220\), and \(d=220\div(22/7)=70\) m.
